instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: When I work alone I like the even light from the ceiling fixture. During a projected presentation keep the room dim and light just the craft table.
context.task: Turn on a light for the person working on a puzzle.

motion_options.A: Point at the selected arrangement and leave it in place.
motion_options.B: Switch the selected light off and switch on the other light.
